description: This file contains utility functions for safely reading and writing configuration files, including renaming files and choosing between original and backup files. It appears to be part of a larger project related to configuration management and backup handling in C.

methods.name: void safeFileSave(char * tempFile,char * originalFile,char * backupFile)
methods.description: Safely saves a file by renaming a temporary file to the desired filename and creating a backup if the original exists. It handles errors during renaming and unlinking, logging warnings appropriately.

methods.name: fileToRead chooseFileToRead(const char * originalFile,const char * backupFile,const char * configDir)
methods.description: Determines whether the original file or a backup file can be read, or if neither exists, attempts to create the directory and suggests a new default file creation.
